# Syntax of INSERT INTO

#### Course: Learn SQL Basics

## Syntax of INSERT INTO

Let's analyze the syntax of the INSERT INTO statement.

![Syntax of INSERT INTO](data:image/png;base64,)

Here,

- INSERT INTO Students: Specifies the table where you want to add data (in this case, Students).
- (id, name, course_id, GPA): Lists the columns in the table that you will fill with data.
- VALUES (6, 'Emma Stone', 'C101', 3.8): Assigns values to the columns in the specified order.
